Usage: memoriahub screenshots [options] [folder...]

Find files with 'screenshot' in the name (case-insensitive); list, move, or
delete matches

Arguments:
  folder             Paths to folders to scan (omit to use --all)

Options:
  --all              Scan all registered enabled folders (default: false)
  --dry-run          Preview matches/moves/deletes without touching any files
                     (default: false)
  -r, --recursive    Descend into sub-directories (when auto-registering a
                     folder) (default: false)
  --concurrency <n>  Number of concurrent workers
  --move-to <dir>    Move every matched screenshot into <dir>
  --delete           Permanently delete every matched screenshot (default:
                     false)
  --json             Emit the summary as JSON instead of a table (default:
                     false)
  -h, --help         display help for command

Examples:
  $ memoriahub screenshots ~/Photos                       # list screenshots found in a folder
  $ memoriahub screenshots ~/Photos -r                    # ...and its sub-folders
  $ memoriahub screenshots --all --move-to ~/Screenshots   # move screenshots out of every registered folder
  $ memoriahub screenshots ~/Photos --delete --dry-run     # preview what --delete would remove
  $ memoriahub screenshots ~/Photos --delete               # permanently delete matches (no prompt — dry-run first!)
